text: And Jehovah{H3068} spake{H1696} unto Moses,{H4872} saying,{H559}

If any one{H5315} sin,{H2398} and commit{H4603} a trespass{H4604} against Jehovah,{H3068} and deal falsely{H3584} with his neighbor{H5997} in a matter of deposit,{H6487} or of bargain,{H8667} or of robbery,{H1498} or have oppressed{H6231} his neighbor,{H5997}

or have found{H4672} that which was lost,{H9} and deal falsely{H8267} therein, and swear{H7650} to a lie;{H8267} in any{H259} of all these things that a man{H120} doeth,{H6213} sinning{H2398} therein;{H2007}

then it shall be, if he hath sinned,{H2398} and is guilty,{H816} that he shall restore{H7725} that{H1500} which he took by robbery,{H1497} or the thing{H6233} which he hath gotten{H6231} by oppression, or the deposit{H6487} which was committed{H6485} to him, or the lost thing{H9} which he found,{H4672}

or any thing about which he hath sworn{H7650} falsely;{H8267} he shall even restore{H7999} it in full,{H7218} and shall add{H3254} the fifth part{H2549} more{H3254} thereto: unto him to whom it appertaineth shall he give{H5414} it, in the day{H3117} of his being found guilty.{H819}

And he shall bring{H935} his trespass-offering{H817} unto Jehovah,{H3068} a ram{H352} without blemish{H8549} out of the flock,{H6629} according to thy estimation,{H6187} for a trespass-offering,{H817} unto the priest:{H3548}
and the priest{H3548} shall make atonement{H3722} for him before{H6440} Jehovah;{H3068} and he shall be forgiven{H5545} concerning whatsoever{H259} he doeth{H6213} so as to be guilty{H819} thereby.
And Jehovah{H3068} spake{H1696} unto Moses,{H4872} saying,{H559}

Command{H6680} Aaron{H175} and his sons,{H1121} saying,{H559} This is the law{H8451} of the burnt-offering:{H5930} the burnt-offering{H5930} shall be on the hearth{H4169} upon the altar{H4196} all night{H3915} unto the morning;{H1242} and the fire{H784} of the altar{H4196} shall be kept burning{H3344} thereon.

And the priest{H3548} shall put{H3847} on his linen{H906} garment,{H4055} and his linen{H906} breeches{H4370} shall he put{H3847} upon his flesh;{H1320} and he shall take up{H7311} the ashes{H1880} whereto the fire{H784} hath consumed{H398} the burnt-offering{H5930} on the altar,{H4196} and he shall put{H7760} them beside{H681} the altar.{H4196}
And he shall put off{H6584} his garments,{H899} and put on{H3847} other{H312} garments,{H899} and carry forth{H3318} the ashes{H1880} without{H2351} the camp{H4264} unto a clean{H2889} place.{H4725}

And the fire{H784} upon the altar{H4196} shall be kept burning{H3344} thereon, it shall not go out;{H3518} and the priest{H3548} shall burn{H1197} wood{H6086} on it every morning:{H1242} and he shall lay the burnt-offering{H5930} in order{H6186} upon it, and shall burn{H6999} thereon the fat{H2459} of the peace-offerings.{H8002}
Fire{H784} shall be kept burning{H3344} upon the altar{H4196} continually;{H8548} it shall not go out.{H3518}
And this is the law{H8451} of the meal-offering:{H4503} the sons{H1121} of Aaron{H175} shall offer{H7126} it before{H6440} Jehovah,{H3068} before{H6440} the altar.{H4196}

And he shall take{H7311} up therefrom his handful,{H7062} of the fine flour{H5560} of the meal-offering,{H4503} and of the oil{H8081} thereof, and all the frankincense{H3828} which is upon the meal-offering,{H4503} and shall burn{H6999} it upon the altar{H4196} for a sweet{H5207} savor,{H7381} as the memorial{H234} thereof, unto Jehovah.{H3068}

And that which is left{H3498} thereof shall Aaron{H175} and his sons{H1121} eat:{H398} it shall be eaten{H398} without leaven{H4682} in a holy{H6918} place;{H4725} in the court{H2691} of the tent{H168} of meeting{H4150} they shall eat{H398} it.

It shall not be baken{H644} with leaven.{H2557} I have given{H5414} it as their portion{H2506} of my offerings made by fire;{H801} it is most{H6944} holy,{H6944} as the sin-offering,{H2403} and as the trespass-offering.{H817}

Every male{H2145} among the children{H1121} of Aaron{H175} shall eat{H398} of it, as [his] portion{H2706} for ever{H5769} throughout your generations,{H1755} from the offerings{H801} of Jehovah{H3068} made by fire:{H801} whosoever toucheth{H5060} them shall be holy.{H6942}
And Jehovah{H3068} spake{H1696} unto Moses,{H4872} saying,{H559}

This is the oblation{H7133} of Aaron{H175} and of his sons,{H1121} which they shall offer{H7126} unto Jehovah{H3068} in the day{H3117} when he is anointed:{H4886} the tenth part{H6224} of an ephah{H374} of fine flour{H5560} for a meal-offering{H4503} perpetually,{H8548} half{H4276} of it in the morning,{H1242} and half{H4276} thereof in the evening.{H6153}

On a baking-pan{H4227} it shall be made{H6213} with oil;{H8081} when it is soaked,{H7246} thou shalt bring{H935} it in: in baken{H7246} pieces{H6595} shalt thou offer{H7126} the meal-offering{H4503} for a sweet{H5207} savor{H7381} unto Jehovah.{H3068}

And the anointed{H4899} priest{H3548} that shall be in his stead from among his sons{H1121} shall offer{H6213} it: by a statute{H2706} for ever{H5769} it shall be wholly{H3632} burnt{H6999} unto Jehovah.{H3068}
And every meal-offering{H4503} of the priest{H3548} shall be wholly burnt:{H3632} it shall not be eaten.{H398}
And Jehovah{H3068} spake{H1696} unto Moses,{H4872} saying,{H559}

Speak{H1696} unto Aaron{H175} and to his sons,{H1121} saying,{H559} This is the law{H8451} of the sin-offering:{H2403} in the place{H4725} where the burnt-offering{H2403} is killed{H7819} shall the sin-offering{H5930} be killed{H7819} before{H6440} Jehovah:{H3068} it is most{H6944} holy.{H6944}
The priest{H3548} that offereth it for sin{H2398} shall eat{H398} it: in a holy{H6918} place{H4725} shall it be eaten,{H398} in the court{H2691} of the tent{H168} of meeting.{H4150}

Whatsoever shall touch{H5060} the flesh{H1320} thereof shall be holy;{H6942} and when there is sprinkled{H5137} of the blood{H1818} thereof upon any garment,{H899} thou shalt wash{H3526} that whereon it was sprinkled{H5137} in a holy{H6918} place.{H4725}

But the earthen{H2789} vessel{H3627} wherein it is boiled{H1310} shall be broken;{H7665} and if it be boiled{H1310} in a brazen{H5178} vessel,{H3627} it shall be scoured,{H4838} and rinsed{H7857} in water.{H4325}
Every male{H2145} among the priests{H3548} shall eat{H398} thereof: it is most{H6944} holy.{H6944}

And no sin-offering,{H2403} whereof any of the blood{H1818} is brought{H935} into the tent{H168} of meeting{H4150} to make atonement{H3722} in the holy{H6944} place, shall be eaten:{H398} it shall be burnt{H8313} with fire.{H784}
